title: The graph: columns of nodes, links and the lit path, in plain SVG or 🧱 bricks charts
goal: A component draws request, pilot, role, route and model columns with their links and lights the chosen path
acceptance: Read docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md and docs/agents/angular.md first; tokens only, no new literal colour; a new shared component updates the style guide in the same change
Lit path animates once on a new sortie and respects reduced motion; the path is also a text list for screen readers; works at phone width (scrolls inside its box)
A component test with a fixture decision; no backlog IDs in text
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
